endpoints.name: Get All

endpoints.name: Create Branch Request

idempotency.notes: Not idempotent; repeating the call may perform the action again; each call writes another audit log entry

endpoints.detailed_description: Create branch request. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IBranchRequest.CreateBranchRequestAsync, ICMSComplaints.CreateComplaintFilesRange, then writes an audit log entry, then processes uploaded files. Persists changes to: CMS_CreditNoteRequisition: INSERT, ComplaintsFile: INSERT, AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Invalid data provided. [when !ModelState.IsValid]; message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: No valid token provided. [when current_user == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to create branch request
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.operation_summary: Create branch request — validates the request, calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IBranchRequest.CreateBranchRequestAsync, ICMSComplaints.CreateComplaintFilesRange, writes an audit log entry, processes uploaded files
business_logic.preconditions: No authentication required; request body of type PostCreateData (inline); passes 2 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.state_changes: CMS_CreditNoteRequisition: INSERT; ComplaintsFile: INSERT; AuditLog: INSERT
business_logic.validations: ModelState (DTO data-annotation) validation; Invalid data provided.
business_logic.side_effects: AuditLog CREATE (Complaint Management System > Branch Requests > Branch Request); Handles file upload/storage
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
